scope: Recorded final step 3072 only. Four groups of eight responses on 128 held-out prompts per domain/seed. PCMD pools 32 responses within each prompt and uses the recorded 30-defined-prompt reporting threshold. Missing/conflicted cells are retained as gaps, never replaced with earlier checkpoints.

summary_policy.pass8: Mean four groups per seed/domain, then equal domains within each of five common seeds, then mean seeds. MathIR is excluded consistently at all levels because its Level-3 MaxRL seed 45 terminal cell is conflicted.
summary_policy.pcmd: Average eligible seeds within each method/domain, then equal weight across the three domains. Descriptive only: contributing seeds differ by method and level; no paired-effect or uncertainty claim.
